title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Ezra 7: Ezra the scribe goes up from Babylon with a letter from King Artaxerxes.

questions.text: How is Ezra described when he went up from Babylon?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:6 says he was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses.

answers.text: The governor of Judah
A skilled scribe in the law of Moses
The cup bearer to the king
A captain of the king's army

questions.text: To whom does Ezra's family line in verses 1-5 go back?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:5 ends the list with Aaron the chief priest.

answers.text: Aaron the chief priest
David the king
Moses
Joshua the son of Nun

questions.text: On which day did Ezra come to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:9 says he began to go up on the first day of the first month and came to Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month.

answers.text: The first day of the first month
The tenth day of the seventh month
The fourteenth day of the second month
The first day of the fifth month

questions.text: What had Ezra set his heart to do?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:10 says Ezra had set his heart to seek Yahweh's law, to do it, and to teach statutes and ordinances in Israel.

answers.text: Rebuild the wall of Jerusalem with the king's help
Become a ruler among the princes of Persia
Seek Yahweh's law, do it, and teach it in Israel
Write down the history of the kings of Judah

questions.text: What title does Artaxerxes give himself in his letter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:12 opens the letter with "Artaxerxes, king of kings."

answers.text: King of kings
Lord of all the earth
King of Babylon and Egypt
Servant of the God of heaven

questions.text: By whom was Ezra sent to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:14 says he was sent by the king and his seven counselors.

answers.text: By the elders of Judah
By the king and his seven counselors
By the high priest in Jerusalem
By the governor beyond the River

questions.text: Up to how much silver were the treasurers beyond the River to give Ezra?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:22 says up to one hundred talents of silver.

answers.text: Ten talents
One thousand talents
One hundred talents
Fifty talents

questions.text: On whom was it not lawful to impose tribute, custom or toll?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:24 names the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants and laborers of God's house.

answers.text: The merchants and goldsmiths of Jerusalem
The governors and treasurers beyond the River
The king's seven counselors and princes
The priests, Levites and other workers of God's house

questions.text: Whom did Artaxerxes tell Ezra to appoint?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:25 says Ezra was to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people beyond the River.

answers.text: Captains and horsemen
Tax collectors
Magistrates and judges
New kings for the provinces

questions.text: For what does Ezra bless Yahweh at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Ezra 7:27 says Yahweh put it in the king's heart to beautify Yahweh's house in Jerusalem.

answers.text: Moving the king to beautify his house
Giving Ezra victory over his enemies
Ending the famine in Judah
Making Ezra governor of the land
